visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair sits on a black leather sofa, clutching a large grey plush cat head. She is wearing a grey zip-up hoodie over a white t-shirt. The background features a wooden bookshelf filled with books and a framed circular portrait. She holds a remote and then looks at her smartphone with a neutral expression. (2) Close-up shot of a smartphone screen showing a messaging interface with a chat bubble. The girl’s face reflects in the screen as she reads a message. (3) The girl looks distressed and anxious while typing on her phone; she is shown in a medium shot. The lighting is soft and indoor. (4) Close-up of the phone screen showing a 'Send Failed' error message. (5) A fast-paced montage follows, showing the girl in various locations within her apartment: running past a pink door, standing on a treadmill, leaning against a large window, and climbing onto a kitchen counter. In each scene, she holds her phone high in the air, appearing desperate for a signal. (6) The scene shifts to a bright studio setting. The girl explains a service to the camera, wearing different casual outfits including a white-and-black raglan tee and a blue cardigan. (7) She is shown in an outdoor street setting with a brick wall background, talking on her phone. (8) Detailed product shots of silver Wi-Fi routers appear as overlays. (9) The girl concludes by making a heart gesture with her hands in front of a white wall with a brand logo and colorful circular graphics.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young female with long, straight dark hair. She wears a grey zip-up hoodie, a white and black raglan t-shirt, and sometimes a dark blue cardigan with a brown leather shoulder bag.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: An indoor apartment with a black sofa, wooden bookshelves, a pink door, and a treadmill; an outdoor brick wall alleyway; a bright white studio background with promotional text overlays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Low-tempo synth BGM begins with a steady rhythmic pulse. The atmosphere is quiet. (2) A sharp 'ding' notification sound occurs. (3) A female voice enters, narrating her inner thoughts in a high-pitched, anxious tone with a fast speech rate. The BGM maintains a suspenseful texture. (4) A digital UI error sound triggers as the message fails to send. (5) The girl's voice becomes more urgent and desperate, asking 'Eh? Why won't it send?'. (6) The music transitions into a fast-paced orchestral sequence with rapid-fire string staccatos and whoosh sound effects every time the scene cuts. (7) A loud vocalization of 'Help!' is heard. (8) A sharp doorbell chime sounds. (9) The audio shifts abruptly into a bright, upbeat pop track with a strong four-on-the-floor beat. The female narrator's voice becomes professional, enthusiastic, and clear, describing the features of an internet service. (10) Subtle digital clicking and UI interaction sound effects are layered over the promo narration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Crisis -> Solution -> Benefit Analysis -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous, 'horror-style' scenario of an introvert being forced into a social gathering because of a bad internet connection (failed message sending) to promote the 'Good Speed, Better Together' internet plan by Taiwan Mobile. It highlights the benefits of Wi-Fi 6 and 5G integration for seamless connectivity and sustainable living.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand name, display of the brand logo, and detailed explanation of service packages and pricing.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges a relatable social anxiety meme with a technical product solution, using high-intensity editing to maintain engagement throughout the transition from comedy to commerce.
